saints.name: Our Lady of Sorrows
saints.title: Memorial of the Sorrowful Mother
saints.shortBlurb: The Church contemplates the Mother of Jesus sharing, in her heart, the sufferings of her Son…
biography: Kept the day after the Exaltation of the Cross, this memorial honours Mary standing by the Cross of her Son, in whom the prophecy of Simeon was fulfilled: "a sword shall pierce your own soul." Devotion to her compassion took shape especially through the Servite friars, who spread the meditation on her Seven Sorrows.

The Church remembers the Mother who suffered with Christ from Bethlehem to Calvary and stood faithful at his death, and holds her before the faithful as the model of those who share in the Passion of the Lord.
saints.knownFor: The seven sorrows of the Mother of Jesus, faithful at the foot of the Cross.

sources.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), "Feast of the Seven Sorrows of the Blessed Virgin Mary"
